state.paragraph: On August 15, 2013, the Special Committee held a telephonic meeting for the purpose of reviewing the on-going strategic alternatives process. By invitation of the Special Committee, representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and Goodwin Procter were also in attendance. BofA Merrill Lynch updated the Special Committee as to the current status of the strategic alternatives process, including the due diligence process and the management presentations with Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona. After discussion and as discussed at the July 25 th Special Committee meeting, the Special Committee authorized and instructed BofA Merrill Lynch to send a letter to each of Party A, Party B, Party C and CSC/Pamplona once all four of the bidders' due diligence was substantially complete requesting that, in light of the results of the respective party's due diligence, such party submit a revised written proposal in order to continue in the process, including to engage in more in-depth and confirmatory due diligence of Mac-Gray.

ledger_rows.Note: Staged disclosure: Party B and Party C (financial) to get broad data-site access; Party A and CSC/Pamplona (strategic) limited access, customer data withheld until later.
Signed after non-solicitation terms were agreed 07/27/2013; informational package provided to potentially improve the June 21 proposal.
BofA letter instructed revised written proposals by 09/09/2013 to continue to in-depth evaluation; covered valuation, financing, approvals and diligence focus.
Round 2 due date reached; CSC/Pamplona and Party B submitted; Party A and Party C submitted late and were reviewed on 09/11/2013.
